subtitle: Lesson 65 · Dashboard Design & Storytelling

code:
3D charts            -- exaggerates differences
Truncated axes       -- same
Pie past 8 slices    -- angles compare poorly
Mismatched scales    -- flattens the smaller series
caption: Each of these genuinely misleads a viewer.

code:
"3,400,000"  ->  "3.4 million"
Sort by measure  = highlight extremes
Sort by category = help someone find one item
caption: Both are storytelling decisions, not defaults.
Consistent color and scale — a treemap where size sorts itself.
